verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs explicitly describe instant rollback to a previous deployment without rebuild for swift incident recovery, matching the one-click rollback story closely (vercel-docs-5, vercel-docs-29). This is corroborated by related gradual-rollout/promote-or-rollback functionality. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the rollback UX and any edge-case limitations (e.g., config/env var changes not covered by rollback).
